facts.business: Tarsons Products Limited is an Indian labware company engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of consumables, reusables, and benchtop equipment used in laboratories across research organizations, academic institutions, pharmaceutical companies, CROs, diagnostic companies, and hospitals.

capacity_or_capex.item: Panchla facility for cell culture, bioprocess products and capacity expansion
Amta facility with in-house radiation sterilization plant, fulfilment centre and manufacturing

guidance_or_targets.statement: In 2026–27, the Company aims to build on the strong foundation established in the previous year by leveraging its expanded manufacturing capabilities, introducing new products, including cell culture and bioprocess products, strengthening its presence in the domestic and international labware markets.

key_risks: Forward-looking statements subject to assumptions, risks and uncertainties
Impairment risk on investment in subsidiary Tarsons Life Science Pte Ltd
Expected credit loss on financial guarantee provided for subsidiary's external borrowings
facts.related_party_note: Financial guarantee provided by the Company for external borrowings availed by the subsidiary Tarsons Life Science Pte Ltd
